summary: Reproduced that the public sgl_kernel.flash_attn entrypoints ignored ver and always crossed the FA3 backend boundary. The KV-cache entrypoint also lacked the architecture guard. The Python contract now accepts only ver=3, rejects unsupported versions before native dispatch, and reports support only for the explicit FA3 CMake targets sm80, sm86, and sm90. CUDA version comparison is numeric and ROCm returns unsupported cleanly.

tests.what_was_measured: The checked-out public entrypoint reached the instrumented torch.ops.sgl_kernel.fwd FA3 boundary for ver=2, ver=4, and invalid values; sm89 and other non-built capabilities were reported supported; the KV-cache path did not reject an unsupported architecture. Thirteen contract assertions failed and six baseline assertions passed after correcting only the test instrumentation.

22 tests passed. They inspect the FA3 compiler targets in CMake, cover supported and unsupported capabilities, CUDA 12.3/12.10/older/ROCm version handling, verify ver=3 reaches the FA3 boundary for KV-cache and varlen entrypoints, and verify unsupported versions and architectures are rejected before native dispatch.
The modified public wrapper and regression test compile as Python source.
No whitespace errors in the patch.

The existing GPU test module cannot collect in the prepared ROCm environment because its local helper compares torch.version.cuda=None with a string. This is an environment/test-helper blocker, not evidence for CUDA behavior.

gpu_execution_evidence: The prepared interpreter is torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 with torch.version.cuda=None and one AMD Instinct MI355X. No NVIDIA GPU, nvcc, cuobjdump, or nvidia-smi is available. The AMD GPU was not used as evidence for NVIDIA FA3 behavior.
remaining_limitations: CUDA binary contents were not independently disassembled because no CUDA toolkit or built CUDA flash_ops library is present.
SM89 execution and numerical output remain unverified because no NVIDIA GPU is assigned.
The source-level compiler evidence is python/sglang/kernels/aot/CMakeLists.txt, whose FA3 target flags are sm80, sm86, and sm90a; the regression test extracts these targets directly.
No native source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable. The source wrapper under validation is python/sglang/kernels/aot/python/sgl_kernel/flash_attn.py.
